Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), marked leukocyturia, nitrite positivity, and proteinuria. Presence of hematuria and elevated urine glucose may warrant further evaluation for possible underlying conditions (e.g., diabetes, glomerular involvement). Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
